080        public void init(InteractionDialogAPI dialog) {
081                this.dialog = dialog;

083//              dialog.hideVisualPanel();

085                
086                textPanel = dialog.getTextPanel();
087                options = dialog.getOptionPanel();
088                visual = dialog.getVisualPanel();
089
090                playerFleet = Global.getSector().getPlayerFleet();
091                planet = (PlanetAPI) dialog.getInteractionTarget();
092                
093                visual.setVisualFade(0.25f, 0.25f);
094                
095                if (planet.getCustomInteractionDialogImageVisual() != null) {
096                        visual.showImageVisual(planet.getCustomInteractionDialogImageVisual());
097                } else {
098                        if (!Global.getSettings().getBoolean("3dPlanetBGInInteractionDialog")) {
099                                visual.showPlanetInfo(planet);
100                        }
101                }
102        
103                dialog.setOptionOnEscape("Leave", OptionId.LEAVE);
104                
105                optionSelected(null, OptionId.INIT);
106        }

116        public void optionSelected(String text, Object optionData) {
117                if (optionData == null) return;
118                
119                if (optionData == DumpMemory.OPTION_ID) {
120                        Map<String, MemoryAPI> memoryMap = new HashMap<String, MemoryAPI>();
121                        MemoryAPI memory = dialog.getInteractionTarget().getMemory();
122                        
123                        memoryMap.put(MemKeys.LOCAL, memory);
124                        if (dialog.getInteractionTarget().getFaction() != null) {
125                                memoryMap.put(MemKeys.FACTION, dialog.getInteractionTarget().getFaction().getMemory());
126                        } else {
127                                memoryMap.put(MemKeys.FACTION, Global.getFactory().createMemory());
128                        }
129                        memoryMap.put(MemKeys.GLOBAL, Global.getSector().getMemory());
130                        memoryMap.put(MemKeys.PLAYER, Global.getSector().getCharacterData().getMemory());
131                        
132                        if (dialog.getInteractionTarget().getMarket() != null) {
133                                memoryMap.put(MemKeys.MARKET, dialog.getInteractionTarget().getMarket().getMemory());
134                        }
135                        
136                        new DumpMemory().execute(null, dialog, null, memoryMap);
137                        
138                        return;
139                } else if (DevMenuOptions.isDevOption(optionData)) {
140                        DevMenuOptions.execute(dialog, (String) optionData);
141                        return;
142                }
143                
144                OptionId option = (OptionId) optionData;
145                
146                if (text != null) {
147                        //textPanel.addParagraph(text, Global.getSettings().getColor("buttonText"));
148                        dialog.addOptionSelectedText(option);
149                }
150                
151                String type = "star";
152                String corona = "star's corona";
153                String corona2 = "in the star's corona";
154                if (planet.getSpec().isBlackHole()) {
155                        type = "black hole";
156                        corona = "event horizon";
157                        corona2 = "near the event horizon";
158                }
159                
160                switch (option) {
161                case INIT:
162                        //boolean scannedAlready = planet.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().getBoolean(BLACK_HOLE_SCANNED);
163                        boolean didAlready = planet.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().getBoolean(ADDED_KEY);
164                        addText(getString("approach"));
165                        
166                        if (planet.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().getBoolean("$abyssalBlackHoleReadings")) {
167                                planet.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().unset("$abyssalBlackHoleReadings");
168                                planet.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().set("$abyssalBlackHoleReadingsRevisit", true);
169                                
170                                addText("Your sensors officer hesitates, then calls for your attention. \"Captain, there's a... pattern. "
171                                                + "From the black hole. Or, rather,\" they pause, looking almost embarrassed. \"-The energy radiated"
172                                                + " by the accretion disc."
173                                                + "\n\n"
174                                                + "They pull a collated sensor output map into the primary holo. \"It's almost a signal. See, if we "
175                                                + "chart these fluctuations in energy output over time..."
176                                                + "\n\n"
177                                                + "You see it now, an orderly series. Not quite a sequence of prime numbers, "
178                                                + "unless you jig the math. Statistically this is nearly impossible. Possible explanations "
179                                                + "are as unlikely: a series of planets - large moons? - with specific mass-ratio relationships, "
180                                                + "all pulled into the accretion disc at just such an angle, like an intentional "
181                                                + "message... or orderly annihilation of a constructed planetary system at a scale beyond the wildest "
182                                                + "dreams of the most bloody-minded war-planners of the Domain."
183                                                + "\n\n"
184                                                + "It can't be known. The pattern disappears as quickly as it arose.");
185                                
186                                int points = HTPoints.ABYSSAL_BLACK_HOLE_UNUSUAL_READINGS;
187                                if (points > 0) {
188                                        HyperspaceTopographyEventIntel.addFactorCreateIfNecessary(
189                                                new HTNonASBScanFactor("Picked up unusual readings from abyssal black hole", points), dialog);
190                                }
191                        } else if (planet.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().getBoolean("$abyssalBlackHoleReadingsRevisit")) {
192                                addText("Your sensors officer detects no more unusual energy patterns from the inner rim of the accretion disc, just noise,"
193                                                + " as mindless as the background radiation of the cosmos itself.");
194                        }
195                        
196                        if (didAlready) {
197                                addText("The " + corona + " exhibits fluctuations indicative of recent antimatter application.");
198                        }
199//                      if (scannedAlready) {
200//                              addText("You've scanned this black hole.");
201//                      }
202                        
203                        Description desc = Global.getSettings().getDescription(planet.getCustomDescriptionId(), Type.CUSTOM);
204                        if (desc != null && desc.hasText3()) {
205                                addText(desc.getText3());
206                        }
207                        createInitialOptions();
208                        break;
209                case DUMP_PLANETKILLER:
210                        addText("Your officers respond promptly to the order, and move to the task with all alacrity. There is an edge to their call-and-response,"
211                                        + " however, as if they cannot help but acknowledge the deep sense of the gravity in this act.\n"
212                                        + "\"Package ready to drop, captain,\" your ops chief says. \"On your order.\"");
213                        options.clearOptions();
214                        options.addOption("\"Destroy it!\"", OptionId.DUMP_PLANETKILLER_CONT_1, null);
215                        options.addOption("\"No... I will keep it.\"", OptionId.DUMP_PLANETKILLER_ON_SECOND_THOUGHT, null); // Isildur, nooo!!!
216                        break;
217                case DUMP_PLANETKILLER_ON_SECOND_THOUGHT:
218                        createInitialOptions();
219                        break;
220                case DUMP_PLANETKILLER_CONT_1:
221                        addText("At your command the planetkiller, locked in its cradle, is boosted toward the very center of the black hole, up and over the plane of the accretion disc.\n\n"
222                                        + "With a flash only a little more than noise in the sensor telemetry, it is gone."); //, like tears in rain"); - OMG Alex, you're killing me -dgb
223                        AddRemoveCommodity.addItemLossText(new SpecialItemData(Items.PLANETKILLER, null), 1, dialog.getTextPanel());
224                        Global.getSector().getPlayerStats().addStoryPoints(1, dialog.getTextPanel(), false);
225                        removePK();
226                        options.clearOptions();
227                        options.addOption("Leave", OptionId.LEAVE, null);
228                        options.setShortcut(OptionId.LEAVE, Keyboard.KEY_ESCAPE, false, false, false, true);
229                        break;
230//              case SCAN_BlACK_HOLE:
231//                      planet.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().set(BLACK_HOLE_SCANNED, true);
232//                      addText("TODO TODO TODO Your sensors officer works quickly, initiating a multi-wave scan of the black hole - or, rather, its event horizon. "
233//                                      + "A few minutes later, you have the data; "
234//                                      + "not terribly useful on its own, but gradually reaching a critical mass "
235//                                      + "when combined with other readings taken elsewhere.");
236//                      HyperspaceTopographyEventIntel.addFactorCreateIfNecessary(new HTBlackHoleFactor(), dialog);
237//                      createInitialOptions();
238//                      break;
239                case ADD_STABLE_CONFIRM:
240                        StarSystemAPI system = planet.getStarSystem();
241                        if (system != null) {
242                                
243                                CargoAPI cargo = Global.getSector().getPlayerFleet().getCargo();
244                                cargo.removeFuel(STABLE_FUEL_REQ);
245                                AddRemoveCommodity.addCommodityLossText(Commodities.FUEL, STABLE_FUEL_REQ, dialog.getTextPanel());
246                                StarSystemGenerator.addStableLocations(system, 1);
247                                planet.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().set(ADDED_KEY, true);
248                                addText("Preparations are made, and you give the go-ahead. " +
249                                                "A few tense minutes later, the chief engineer reports success. " +
250                                                "The resulting stable location won't last for millennia, like " +
251                                                "naturally-occurring ones - but it'll do for your purposes.");
252                        }
253                        createInitialOptions();
254                        break;
255                case ADD_STABLE_DESCRIBE:
256                        addText("The procedure requires spreading prodigious amounts of antimatter " + corona2 + ", " +
257                                        "according to calculations far beyond the ability of anything on the right side of the " +
258                                        "treaty that ended the Second AI War.");
259                        boolean canAfford = dialog.getTextPanel().addCostPanel("Resources required (available)", 
260                                        Commodities.ALPHA_CORE, 1, false,
261                                        Commodities.HEAVY_MACHINERY, STABLE_MACHINERY_REQ, false,
262                                        Commodities.FUEL, STABLE_FUEL_REQ, true
263                                        );
264                        
265                        options.clearOptions();
266                        
267                        int num = Misc.getNumStableLocations(planet.getStarSystem());
268                        boolean alreadyCant = false;
269                        if (num <= 0) {
270                                options.addOption("Proceed with the operation", OptionId.ADD_STABLE_CONFIRM, null);
271                        } else if (num < 2) {
272                                addText("Normally, this procedure can only be performed in a star system without any " +
273                                                "stable locations. However, your chief engineer suggests an unorthodox workaround.");
274                                options.addOption("Proceed with the operation", OptionId.ADD_STABLE_CONFIRM, null);
275                                SetStoryOption.set(dialog, Global.getSettings().getInt("createStableLocation"), 
276                                                OptionId.ADD_STABLE_CONFIRM, "createStableLocation", Sounds.STORY_POINT_SPEND_TECHNOLOGY,
277                                                "Created additional stable location in " + planet.getStarSystem().getNameWithLowercaseType() + "");
278                        } else {
279                                alreadyCant = true;
280                                
281                                String reason = "This procedure can not performed in a star system that already has " +
282                                                                "numerous stable locations.";
283                                options.addOption("Proceed with the operation", OptionId.ADD_STABLE_CONFIRM, null);
284                                options.setEnabled(OptionId.ADD_STABLE_CONFIRM, false);
285                                addText(reason);
286                                options.setTooltip(OptionId.ADD_STABLE_CONFIRM, reason);
287                        }
288                        
289                        if (!canAfford && !alreadyCant) {
290                                String reason = "You do not have the necessary resources to carry out this procedure.";
291                                options.setEnabled(OptionId.ADD_STABLE_CONFIRM, false);
292                                addText(reason);
293                                options.setTooltip(OptionId.ADD_STABLE_CONFIRM, reason);
294                        }
295                        
296                        
297                        options.addOption("Never mind", OptionId.ADD_STABLE_NEVER_MIND, null);
298                        //createInitialOptions();
299                        break;
300                case ADD_STABLE_NEVER_MIND:
301                        createInitialOptions();
302                        break;
303                case LEAVE:
304                        if (unpauseOnExit) {
305                                Global.getSector().setPaused(false);
306                        }
307                        dialog.dismiss();
308                        break;
309                }
310        }

313        protected void createInitialOptions() {
314                options.clearOptions();
315                
316                MemoryAPI memory = dialog.getInteractionTarget().getMemory();
317                
318                String type = "star";
319                String corona = "star's corona";
320                String corona2 = "in the star's corona";
321                boolean blackHole = false;
322                if (planet.getSpec().isBlackHole()) {
323                        blackHole = true;
324                        type = "black hole";
325                        corona = "event horizon";
326                        corona2 = "near the event horizon";
327                }
328                
329                StarSystemAPI system = planet.getStarSystem();
330                //boolean scannedAlready = planet.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().getBoolean(BLACK_HOLE_SCANNED);
331                boolean didAlready = planet.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().getBoolean(ADDED_KEY);
332                boolean deepSpace = system.isDeepSpace();
333                if (system != null && planet == system.getStar() && !didAlready && !deepSpace) {
334//                      int num = Misc.getNumStableLocations(planet.getStarSystem());
335                        //options.addOption("Induce a resonance cascade in the star's hyperfield, creating a stable location", OptionId.ADD_STABLE_DESCRIBE, null);
336                        options.addOption("Consider inducing a resonance cascade in the " + type + "'s hyperfield, creating a stable location", OptionId.ADD_STABLE_DESCRIBE, null);
337//                      SetStoryOption.set(dialog, Global.getSettings().getInt("createStableLocation"), 
338//                                      OptionId.ADD_STABLE, "createStableLocation", Sounds.STORY_POINT_SPEND_TECHNOLOGY);
339//                      if (num >= 3) {
340//                              options.setEnabled(OptionId.ADD_STABLE, false);
341//                              options.setTooltip(OptionId.ADD_STABLE, "This star system can't have any more stable locations.");
342//                      }
343//                      if (num >= 0) {
344//                              options.setEnabled(OptionId.ADD_STABLE, false);
345//                              options.setTooltip(OptionId.ADD_STABLE, "This procedure can only be performed in star systems " +
346//                                                                                                              "without any stable locations.");
347//                      }
348                }
349                
350//              if (blackHole && !scannedAlready) {
351//                      options.addOption("Scan the black hole to assess its impact on local hyperspace topography",
352//                                      OptionId.SCAN_BlACK_HOLE, null);
353//              }
354                
355                
356                if (hasPK() && blackHole == true) {
357                        options.addOption("Dump the planetkiller weapon into the black hole", OptionId.DUMP_PLANETKILLER, null);
358                }
359                
360                options.addOption("Leave", OptionId.LEAVE, null);
361                options.setShortcut(OptionId.LEAVE, Keyboard.KEY_ESCAPE, false, false, false, true);
362                
363                if (Global.getSettings().isDevMode()) {
364                        DevMenuOptions.addOptions(dialog);
365                }
366        }

368        public void removePK() {
369                Global.getSector().getPlayerFleet().getCargo().
370                                removeItems(CargoItemType.SPECIAL, new SpecialItemData(Items.PLANETKILLER, null), 1);
371        }
372        public boolean hasPK() {
373                return Global.getSector().getPlayerFleet().getCargo().
374                                getQuantity(CargoItemType.SPECIAL, new SpecialItemData(Items.PLANETKILLER, null)) > 0;
375        }

395        private String getString(String id) {
396                String str = Global.getSettings().getString("planetInteractionDialog", id);
397
398                String fleetOrShip = "fleet";
399                if (playerFleet.getFleetData().getMembersListCopy().size() == 1) {
400                        fleetOrShip = "ship";
401                        if (playerFleet.getFleetData().getMembersListCopy().get(0).isFighterWing()) {
402                                fleetOrShip = "fighter wing";
403                        }
404                }
405                str = str.replaceAll("\\$fleetOrShip", fleetOrShip);
406                str = str.replaceAll("\\$planetName", planet.getName());
407                
408                return str;
409        }
